2.name: Episode 32
2.overview: “Taşacak Bu Deniz” returns for its new season right where last season’s breathtaking finale left off. Timur Volkov’s deadly plan forces Adil to make the most difficult choice of his life, pushing their war to a point of no return as Adil fights to save his family. Meanwhile, Esme prepares to face new challenges with the arrival of her formidable mother-in-law, while a common mastermind begins to emerge behind seemingly unrelated enemies. From behind prison walls, Şerif Furtuna continues to advance his grand plan, and the threats against Adil grow stronger. Amid the escalating conflict, Adil and Esme, now the leader of the Furtuna family, face their greatest test yet: refusing to give up on each other. As the war stretches from the Black Sea mountains to Russia and beyond, one thing remains certain: for Adil, Esme, and Eleni, family is worth fighting for.

2.name: Episode 33
2.overview: A threat against his ancestors’ graves pushes Adil Koçari to the brink of crossing boundaries he has never dared to cross. His vow to protect his people, living and dead, gives the villagers hope but deepens Esme’s fears as they are drawn into a war before resolving their own problems. Meanwhile, the Furtunas struggle to rebuild their lives, and İso faces a painful choice between his family and the woman he loves. When Timur targets Esme to save his son Cengiz, Aleyna Koçari steps in, leaving Cengiz’s fate in her hands. An unexpected ally comes to Timur’s aid, changing the course of the conflict. As Emriye’s deadline expires, only a signature stands between the land and its sale to Timur. Adil must now choose between the promise he made to Esme and the oath he swore to his villagers.

2.name: Episode 34
2.overview: Adil and Esme’s divorce hearing falls on October 19, the day they first met. As they struggle to protect the Koçari family and their land while facing Timur’s attacks, the couple finds solace in each other one last time. Determined to prevent the divorce, Adil pursues the person who kidnapped Cengiz, while Oruç faces a painful confrontation with Eleni. Before the divorce, Adil proposes a honeymoon with Esme, and the three people who have been separated for twenty years embark on a journey to confront their past. However, an unexpected turn at the courthouse and Şerif’s move rooted in events from twenty years ago threaten to shatter the fragile hope Adil and Esme have only just begun to regain.
